description:
Activate Karn twice by paying {2}, causing Halo Fountain and Empowered Autogenerator to become a creature.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {W} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Empowered Autogenerator, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
